text: Really sorry to bother you this late. My son is 4 months and his temp was 38.2 earlier. Honestly he seems mostly himself between doses of paracetamol: still taking his bottles, kicking about, cooing and chatting away at me. But when I changed him I noticed some tiny dark red dots on his tummy and a couple on his leg. I don't know if I'm being silly, but I remembered something about pressing a glass on them, so I tried it and I could still see them through the glass, they didn't go away. Could be nothing, I just didn't want to ignore it. Sorry again.
